title: What Is Retained for Occupancy on a Resort Lodging Early Departure
content:
The occupancy charge of a Resort Lodging stay follows the retained nights in the same way the room rate does. What the folio carries for occupancy, and how the nights retained stand against the unit type's late cancellation nights, decide what is retained.

Where the folio carries an occupancy charge posted for the stay and the nights retained number the unit type's late cancellation nights or fewer, the unit type's extra person charge is retained for each guest beyond its standard occupancy for each night retained.

Where the folio carries an occupancy charge posted for the stay and the nights retained number more than the unit type's late cancellation nights, that charge is retained for each such guest for the unit type's late cancellation nights only.

Where the folio carries no occupancy charge posted for the stay, nothing is retained for occupancy.

## The late cancellation nights of each unit type

| Unit type | Late cancellation nights |
| --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 1 |
| Slopeside Studio | 1 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 2 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 2 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 2 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 3 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 5 |

### Both sides of the cap (hypothetical stays in a Summit Penthouse Residence)

The unit type's late cancellation nights number 3, and its extra person charge is taken here as 75.00 USD, on a party carrying 2 guests beyond the standard occupancy.

Where 2 nights are retained on a folio carrying an occupancy charge for the stay, the nights retained number fewer than 3, so 75.00 USD is retained for each of the 2 guests for each of the 2 nights retained, which is 300.00 USD.

Where 5 nights are retained on the same folio, the nights retained number more than 3, so 75.00 USD is retained for each of the 2 guests for 3 nights only, which is 450.00 USD. Exactly 3 nights retained falls in the first of the two, and gives the same figure.

Where the folio carries no occupancy charge posted for the stay, nothing is retained for occupancy however many nights are retained.
